summary: The capture workflow stays. One Odds API request used regions uk,eu,us and markets h2h,totals, costing 6 credits, with 492 remaining. Twenty events came back, all kicking off by 19 October 2026, so only Gameweeks 6 and 7 are priced. On score_xp with the minutes file and current availability, the two-week XI sums are hold 114.99, one free transfer 119.36 (van Ewijk to Hall), and a Gameweek 6 wildcard rebuild 132.58. The wildcard lead over the free transfer is 13.22 across those two weeks, and that rebuild sells Haaland on the Gameweek 6 score of 4.80. Gameweek 8 onward is unknown. This is not a chip-rule result.
